note: The duty window («Реєстр досліджень», the mockup's body[data-f=duty]): an army form on green cloth. The sheet holds the requisites (Долг, the grif stamp, Форма № 7-Д, ЗАТВЕРДЖУЮ), the spaced title, '1. Перелік робіт' (the registry table), '2. Фонди фракції' (the pool table), '3. Схема послідовності робіт' (the tree in a ruled frame) and the executor's line; «Картка дослідження» is a second sheet on a clip, with the seal and the signature. Positions are the mockup's, measured in Chrome (stage 1600x900); the skin script (OZL_TreeSkin_Duty) writes the upper-case and spaced texts and lines up the typed parts.

panel.name: TreeDesk
panel.note: The green cloth of the desk.

image.name: TreeDeskGlow
image.note: The cloth's light: radial-gradient(at 40% 40%, #2f3f36, #18211c 80%) as a white fade tinted #2f3f36.

image.name: StageShadow
image.note: The shadows of the sheet (0 8px 20px .6) and of the card (0 6px 16px .55).

panel.name: Sheet

image.name: SheetGlow
image.note: The paper's faint light and shade (two radial gradients of .dsheet); its own colours.

label.name: OrgName
label.note: Upper case and spaced by the skin (OnShow): <b> of .dorg, 17 px, letter-spacing .12em.

panel.name: OrgRef
panel.note: 'Вих. № 0417/Д': the form's words (OrgRefN0) and the typed number (OrgRefT0) after them; the skin splits the key at its last space and lines the two up by their measured widths (OnUpdate).

icon.name: Grif
icon.note: «Для службового користування», tilted -2 degrees, in a red frame: the GRIF_IMG sprite pair, white, tinted --acc at .85 (the mockup's opacity). The skin loads the language's picture (OnShow).

label.name: ApproveHead
label.note: Upper case and spaced by the skin (OnShow).

panel.name: ApproveCmd
panel.note: 'Командир ___________': the word, then the typed blank (the skin splits at the first space).

panel.name: ApproveDate
panel.note: '«__» __________ р.': every run of underscores is typed (T), the rest is the form's (N).

icon.name: TitleImg
icon.note: «Реєстр досліджень», 34 px, letter-spacing .3em: a picture pair title_ua/title_en, shown when STR_OZL_SKIN_DUTY_TITLE_IMG names it (OnShow); else TitleText.

label.name: TitleText
label.note: The live title: upper case, a space between the letters (the .3em letter-spacing as near as a font can).

panel.name: SubLine
panel.note: 'напрям: <branch> · <faction · досліджено N з M>', centred under the title: the skin lines the four texts up by their measured widths (OnUpdate) with one typed space between them.

label.name: RegHead
label.note: Upper case and spaced by the skin (OnShow).

panel.name: RegHeadRow
panel.note: The head row of the table: № п/п | Найменування | Тир | Стан, 1.5-unit frame, 1-unit column rules; the skin writes the upper-case texts (OnShow).

list.name: RegScroll
list.note: The registry rows (max-height 330, then it scrolls); the bar is 10 units right of the table. The skin shrinks it to its rows and moves FundBlock under it (OnSelect).

row.name: OZL_DutyRegistryRow
row.note: One line of the registry: the menu fills RegNum, RegName, RegTier, RegState, renames RegHit reg:<id> and shows RegPick on the selected node; the skin upper-cases, greys a locked or hidden node's line and, when the status needs two lines (НЕ ВИСТАЧАЄ / РЕСУРСІВ), puts the second in RegState2 and makes the line 33 high. The rules are proportional, so they follow that height.

raw.name: RegHit
raw.note: The click: renamed reg:<id>; hidden on a hidden node's line.

panel.name: FundBlock
PoolBottom
panel.note: The table's bottom edge, 1.5 like its sides: the skin puts it over the last row's rule (OnPaint).

panel.name: PoolEmpty
panel.note: No line at all (the menu shows PoolEmpty then): an empty table with one line of text, not in the mockup.
'2. Фонди фракції' and the pool table; its top is set by the skin to 18 units under the registry.

raw.name: TreeScroll
raw.note: The scheme: the whole frame, the legend sits under it on the sheet. Style blank and the colour make the scrollbars the mockup's thumb (#b8b19c) instead of the engine's white bar.

icon.name: TreeFogEdge
icon.note: The 80-unit fade into the fog: clear at the top, solid at the bottom (the tree grows down).

panel.name: TreeHeadBand
panel.note: The head of the scheme (.thead): paper to 70 %, then a fade (TreeHeadFade) over the scrolled content.

label.name: DevName
label.note: '3. Схема послідовності робіт': upper case and spaced by the skin (OnShow).

panel.name: TreeLegend
panel.note: The legend, under the scheme's frame on the sheet (the owner's call after the stand: inside the frame the typed legend did not fit and was cut). Two lines: the statuses, lined up by their texts 14 apart (LegendRow, FlowLater in OnShow), then the two kinds of link (LegendRow2, the second item 14 after the longer of 'після всіх' / 'after all'). Clear of the executor's line, which ends near x 360.

panel.name: Executor
panel.note: 'Виконавець ст. сержант ________ · тел. 2-14 · прим. № 1': the typed part runs from the second word to the last underscore (ExecutorT0), the rest is the form's (OnShow, OnUpdate).
The sheet of the form (.dsheet), 1104x864 at (24, 18).

label.name: CardHeadText
label.note: 'КАРТКА ДОСЛІДЖЕННЯ · ФОРМА № 7-Д/2' (.c-head::before), spaced by the skin (OnShow).

frame.name: CardSegs
frame.note: The segmented progress bar (.pbar): 20 cells with hairline rules, a done cell hatched red.

frame.name: CardOpensList
frame.note: The chips of 'Відкриває', lined up and wrapped by the menu.

row.name: OZL_DutyCostRow
row.note: One cost line, typed in capitals over a dotted rule (.crow): name, then 'have / need' or 'need' at the right; 6 units under it.

row.name: OZL_DutyOpensChip
row.note: A chip of 'Відкриває' (.opens a): framed capitals, 23 high, 6 under. ChipBoxLine (solid) and ChipDashLine (dashed, a hidden node) are stretched by the menu to the chip's width with ChipHit; their rules are proportional and follow.

frame.name: CardFoot

icon.name: BtnResearchFrame
icon.note: The 4-unit double border; red, grey when the button is disabled (PaintButton).

label.name: BtnResearchText
label.note: Upper case and spaced by the skin (OnSelect): letter-spacing .3em.

label.name: CardSign
label.note: 'Підпис ____________ /Командир/' (.c-foot::after); the skin folds the double space as CSS does.

icon.name: CardScribble
icon.note: The commander's scribble in blue ink over the blank (the ::after background, clipped at the line's foot).

frame.note: The button, the reason under it, the signature: at the foot of the card (.c-foot, margin-top auto).

frame.name: CardStamp

icon.name: CardStampBand
icon.note: The paper band between the rings, as the mockup's multiply blend leaves it on the card.

icon.name: CardStampImg
icon.note: The seal: the menu loads StampOf (SEAL_DONE_IMG / SEAL_WORK_IMG), the skin tints it (OnSelect).

frame.note: The round seal over the button (.c-stamp: right 34, bottom 112, 150x150, -14 degrees, .72), done and researching only.

icon.name: Clip
icon.note: The paper clip over the card's top edge (.clip: 360, -16 of the card, 22x64, 3-unit grey wire).

list.name: TreeTemplates
list.note: Never shown: it only declares the rows that live outside lists.

row.name: OZL_DutyPoolRow
row.note: One line of the funds table: name (upper case) | a short rule | the value, right-aligned in at least 60 units.
